query_normalized: the impact of interoceptive awareness on emotional regulation during simulated stress psychology
rationale: The paper focuses on computational detection of stress in social media text using lexical rules, which is an off-domain application (NLP/sentiment analysis) that does not measure the biological mechanism of interoceptive awareness or the psychological process of emotional regulation in humans under simulated stress.
